Subject: SIG questionnaire — clarification on evidence lifecycle and retention

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the fast turnaround on the initial SIG bundle. Our security team reviewed the control mapping and had a few clarifying asks before we proceed to the technical deep dive: 

- Can you confirm the retention windows and legal basis for the following artifact classes: authentication logs (failed and successful), orchestration-run traces (KV cache eviction logs), and customer-managed workspace exports?
- We need a signed Chain of Custody (COA) for logs provided as part of the RFP (proof that artifacts were exported and not modified). A PDF with an authorized signature is preferred.
- Are there redaction guidelines or a canonical redaction manifest you follow when removing PII from samples? If so, please include an example showing original -> redacted sample lines.
- For evidence that references private deployments, please indicate whether logs are from customer VPC connectors (customer-managed) or captured by Redwood telemetry (control owner).

Target: We’d like the above clarified and a small evidence packet (matrix + two sample artifacts) by end of week so our internal reviewers can move to the next gate. Also note procurement will need a short retention addendum for contract language.

Thanks,
